points.conditions: Native ModelOpt INT4 attention composed with the fixed independently audited FFN allocation; no additional composition training. Original BF16 teacher supplies one shared quality allowance; incremental factors are not multiplied without accounting for overlapping modules. 0 intact BF16 FFNs; exact per-layer allocation is bound in physical request. Layer26 method sparse75_int4_gptq keeps exactly75% of projection values (25% pruned), verified in source screen.construct and algorithms.exact_fraction_mask; historical75%-sparse wording is incorrect.

Endpoint primary, physical selector secondary, original BF16 cumulative reference.
points.limitations: The complete 256-update scientific recovery and allocated paired closure have finished. The exact balanced whole448INT4 parent registers 19,130,362,112 bytes (3.369960263x); its bound GSM64/MC192 prefix is 56/168 and the original BF16 H100 teacher is 55/171. The direct FFN16–23 native PopulationNetwork descendant registers 17,573,798,898 bytes (3.668447585x), 8.1366% fewer bytes than that parent. Its zero-update control is 52/64 GSM and 161/192 MC; the actual QAT256 endpoint is 52/163. All 64 candidate traces answer and stop within two tokens, with no caps or follow-on questions. Endpoint minus initial: GSM 0 items, paired95 [-3,+3] (one gained/one lost), and MC +2 [-2,+6] (three gained/one lost); no capability gain is established. Endpoint minus exact balanced parent: GSM -4 [-10,+2], MC -5 [-13,+3]. C4 NLL improves by 0.002869 nats [-0.004956,-0.000133], the endpoint point increase is 0.09024774, while its one-sided95 upper 0.10274455 still exceeds the original 0.1000 gate. Teacher KL 0.19351540 is a separate readout. Copy512/2048 PPL ratios improve from 1.08825/1.12829 to 0.97445/1.01557 and pass their frozen diagnostic limits. The main measured effect is copy recovery, with small prose improvement and no demonstrated capability recovery. All 256 updates use the fixed 512 unique512-token windows/261632 shifted targets and change all seven cell banks; retained balanced projections, recovered48 adapters,24 norms and topology stay fixed. The physical selector chooses256 (0.154907 at0 to0.151887 at256), and exact FP32 equality binds selected to the same owned endpoint/export/readout; it is not a replicate. The complete endpoint export is17,580,353,309 bytes including its seal. Jobs46161889 and46183545 completed0:0. All original V2 import-guard and aggregate no_marker failures, the V3 cold-reload reconciliation and V4 CPU repair remain preserved in the source/job history. Full development was not run for this descendant; the fixed prefix comparison is complete, with no capability admission or shortlist membership change.

points.label: magnitude50_bf16
points.cohort: exp_20260908_calibrated_teacher_capability | GSM train-dev1024, MC6144, fixed C4/copy; BF16/eager/H200
points.gate_status: mixed (experiment assessment; see original gate record)
points.evidence: measured
points.conditions: Four verified layer-7 exports, common BF16/eager/H200 teacher, GSM1024, MC6144, fixed C4/copy and answer-relative stopping.
points.limitations: The four-candidate layer-7 wave and all six predeclared paired comparisons are complete. Scheduled independent audit 45413027 passed 176,086 raw-item/probe/statistics checks across four new arms and two previous RTN controls, including 42 actual saved probe comparisons. A separate 135-check completion inspection confirmed all request/source/output hashes, exact prior early receipts and six contrast recomputations. INT3 GPTQ alone among the four new candidates passes all five development gates at 356 GSM, 67.0410% MC and 20,447,232 registered site bytes. SparseGPT50 BF16/INT4 fail only GSM at 326/332 correct. Magnitude50 BF16 also fails only GSM: 335 correct, 67.431640625% MC, 56,623,104 bytes and GSM loss upper bound 6.93359375 percentage points against the 5-point limit. It produces one EOS, 1,023 capped traces and zero answered-and-stopped, so the severe magnitude-pruning termination defect exists before INT4. Quantizing the identical magnitude support changes GSM by -3 items, paired 95% interval [-21,15], with zero answered-and-stopped in both states. SparseGPT BF16 versus magnitude BF16 changes GSM by -9 [-38,20], while answered-and-stopped rises by 468 [437,500.025], EOS by 958 [942,973], and C4 gate NLL falls by 0.012659 nats/token. The calibrated pruning recipe improves termination and prose/copy fidelity without an established GSM gain. This comparison changes support selection and retained-value compensation together; it does not identify which component causes the improvement. The accepted dense INT3 result remains a development-qualified site reference, not established superiority over RTN, broad layer coverage, a sparse/dendritic advantage or a runtime claim.

points.label: teacher
points.cohort: exp_20260908_7b_bf16_capability | GSM train-dev 1,024; MC 6,144; fixed C4/copy; BF16/eager/H100
points.gate_status: positive (experiment assessment; see original gate record)
points.evidence: measured
points.conditions: Two complete single-site development comparisons: fresh BF16/eager/H100 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct teacher versus native layer-16 INT4 or INT8, GSM 1,024, MC 6,144, fixed C4 and copy. No historical FP32 reuse, automatic coverage, final-test, latency or allocator-memory claim.
points.limitations: Both native layer-16 quantized references pass all five frozen development gates after independent completion replay. The fresh BF16/H100 teacher scores 573/1,024 GSM and 76.2044% MC; INT4 scores 537 and 76.3021%, and INT8 scores 571 and 76.2370%. INT4 registers 74,012,160 site bytes versus 270,532,608 for the teacher, a 72.64% site reduction but only 1.346% of whole-model registered bytes. INT8 registers 141,645,312 site bytes, a 47.64% site reduction and 0.883% whole-model reduction. INT4 passes narrowly: its GSM loss upper bound is 4.8828 percentage points against a 5-point tolerance; the observed 36-item loss has candidate-minus-teacher paired 95% interval [-52, -19]. INT8 loses two GSM items with interval [-9, 5]. Passing the tolerance does not mean lossless. points.label: INT4 attention plus 15 INT4 FFNs passes development gates at 1.717902x
points.cohort: exp_20260908_attention_selective125_capability | Frozen paired development instrument; 1024 GSM and 6144 MC items
points.gate_status: positive (experiment assessment; see original gate record)
points.evidence: measured
points.conditions: Complete quantization-only 7B composition; original-teacher frozen H100/BF16 development instrument and actual registered tensor bytes.
points.limitations:
Independent CPU replay verifies all five prospectively fixed development gates, raw GSM/MC item identities and parsers, saved 32/512-token and eight-step cached BF16 probes, state receipts and paired statistics. It binds prior full physical-export and teacher audits; 31 outer executable checks and 402 actual file bindings pass. Native attention INT4 plus 15 GPTQ INT4 FFNs and 17 intact BF16 FFNs occupies 8,496,423,424 registered bytes versus teacher 14,596,022,784 (1.717902x). GSM 673/1024 versus 573 has 148 gains and 48 losses; MC is 4656/6144 versus 4682. C4 and copy512/2048 pass. No learned cells, pruning or composition updates. Marker-only strata account for most GSM gain; candidate caps 634 versus 465 and answers promptly stop on 6 versus 66 items. This establishes current development-gate preservation, not improved reasoning, final-test generalization or speed. The review does not rerun GPU inference or rehash full weight checkpoints.

September13 interpretation correction: preserve the original operational gate verdict, but suspend reasoning-preservation/frontier claims until the7Bteacher protocol is qualified. The exact80rawshard/nine-arm audit finds large format/stopping dependence. True marker-conditional accuracy uses marker-only correct counts, excluding fallback corrects; different conditional subsets are not causal effects. A repaired common protocol must freshly evaluate teacher and all historical candidate exports.

points.conditions: Diagnostic separately fitted FFNs16–23 and24–31, followed by physical16–31 composition; attention retained. Full capability and whole-model bytes govern any admission.
points.limitations: The actual unchanged FFNs16-23 and24-31 exports were composed and independently evaluated with zero recovery. Both composition and deletion jobs completed0:0; a68-check independent readback binds the closed per-item payloads and source/reload receipts. Separately, the two chunks scored51/64 GSM,165/192 MC and46/161 versus teacher55/171. Composed, they score8/64 GSM (0 gains,47 teacher losses) and144/192 MC (8 gains,35 losses). Copy512/2048 ratios worsen to1.7763/4.24575 and independent C4 teacher-KL is0.513122. Sixty-one of64 generations reach the cap, with zero answered-and-stopped outputs. Matching16-FFN deletion scores3/64 GSM and129/192 MC; all3 GSM corrects come from fallback, with zero marker-correct answers. Composition registers52,577,507,042 bytes versus64,468,560,128 for the teacher (1.226162x) with exact physical reload. This zero-recovery union must not advance; joint/sequential/hybrid recovery is separately running. The independent readback explicitly adds prefix identities omitted by the frozen worker completion and length-checks large probe payloads rather than claiming a new full-payload rehash.

points.cohort: exp_20260908_32b_large_chunk_memory_repair | GSM8K fixed train development prefix n=64
points.gate_status: mixed (experiment assessment; see original gate record)
points.evidence: measured
points.conditions: Sixteen prospective larger-network fits, attention retained. Local registered-byte factors are separate from final whole-model compression; capability prefixes do not admit models.
points.limitations: The unchanged sixteen graphs and approximately 2x/8x local byte budgets have been relaunched after an execution-only repair: sparse output gathers use the existing 64 MiB workspace policy and unused original FFN archives move to CPU. The widest one-output floor can exceed 64 MiB; this is not a total-memory guarantee. Fifteen geometry CPU tests and eleven actual tiny Olmo2 trainer tests passed; independent staged review passed 19,706 checks across 6,220 files. Each canary first runs actual H200 tiling forward/gradient/optimizer parity, then qualifies the full geometry, every parameter group update and exact selected-export reload. Sixteen two-H200 canaries and sixteen corresponding 1024-step fits are released with same-arm afterok plus executable proof checks. The repair changes neither registered model bytes nor scientific data/optimizer/readouts. No complete full-size fit or capability admission is claimed. Five actual H200 projection tests passed the declared forward/gradient/update criteria. A full-size collapsed arm then exposed a separate ledger-name mismatch: the canonical span wrapper adds span_cell. prefixes to otherwise identical tensors. All twelve collapsed canary/main pairs were retired; four independent-cell pairs remain active. A strict wrapper-aware ledger retry will preserve exact tensor/byte checks. The initial twelve cancelled jobs are not counted as completed fits. The primary independent/wide arms were subsequently retired after primary span8 passed exact selected reload but exhausted GPU memory in copy2048. Frozen local-learning input caches and wide single-cell temporaries require a separate inference tiling/cache policy. Only indices0/4 from execution_v3 and1/5 from execution_v4 are retired for this issue; the other 12 Population arms continue. This is a memory failure, not a capability measurement. September9 continuation: local8_span8_independent completes1024 updates, selects1024, scores47/64 GSM and166/192 MC,C4 selector KL0.16990,copy2048 1.0282. local8_span16_independent also trains1024 and exports selected1024 with exact reload; copy2048 is1.0133 and all64 GSM finish at27 correct versus55 teacher (paired net difference−28,95% interval−37 to−19), then MC scoring OOMs. The latter is a completed training export with incomplete evaluation, not a retraining target. Full capability admission remains absent. Evaluation-only resume45662742_0 now completes the unchanged selected sixteen-FFN independent export:27/64 GSM,150/192 MC versus its own bound H200 BF16 teacher55/171. The GSM paired95% interval is−37 to−19 net items; copy2048 remains1.01326. Complete registered bytes52,577,508,112 give1.226162x compression. Exact original forward32/512 and cached tensors survive two-H200 placement. No training or reselection occurred; prior MC OOM and failed device-node canary remain preserved. No full-development capability admission.

points.label: morph_span8_positive_ei_e2_i1
points.cohort: exp_20260909_population_morphology_screen | GSM8K fixed train development prefix n=64
points.gate_status: mixed (experiment assessment; see original gate record)
points.evidence: measured
points.conditions: Canonical PopulationNetwork compression of FFN spans with native attention retained; final original-teacher capability and whole-model bytes govern admission.
points.limitations: Eight of nine eligible morphology fits completed1024 updates and their exact-reload GSM64/MC192/copy diagnostics. The tree8 canary failed first-backward H100 memory (3.28GiB requested,2.90GiB free); its main was cancelled without a training or capability result. Shunting was deferred before launch and is not a tenth tested fit. All eight completed fits select step1024, so convergence is not established. Positive E:I2:1 scores51/64 GSM and168/192 MC against its own H100 BF16 teacher55/171, C4 selector KL0.20070, copy2048 ratio1.06750. Signed star4 scores49/169 with the lowest morphology selector KL0.17601; signed control scores50/166. Positive2:1 minus control is+1 GSM item, paired95% interval[-5,+7]; every morphology-versus-control interval includes zero. All eight retain nonzero gradient/value changes in every recorded pathway and the positive arms retain nonnegative conductances. All GSM traces reach EOS before the cap,62–64/64 answer and stop within two tokens, and marker/protocol correctness agree. Matched registered replacement bytes about849.3MB imply only1.10159x whole-model compression, not8x. Exact outputs from H100 and H200 teacher cohorts differ despite identical55/171 totals; own-cohort references are retained. No full capability or runtime admission follows. September10 census covers22 completed exports and independently recounts selected signed4-leaf4× and positiveE:I2:1 payloads. The signed candidate has146,844 total soma-neurons and zero dedicated I cells; the positive2:1 candidate has238,840 E and119,420 I neurons,57,321,600 external,9,553,600 I→E and38,215,680 readout contact slots. Positive-family representation/init differs from the signed family, so this is not an isolated I-ratio contrast. A same-recipe positive2:1 fit at FFNs24–31 is now separately submitted after its own passed GPU canary.

points.label: initial
points.cohort: exp_20260907_teacher_channel_initialization | Frozen complete TRAIN-development battery; no final-test evaluation
points.gate_status: negative (experiment assessment; see original gate record)
points.evidence: measured
points.conditions: One width-967 FP32 dense SwiGLU initialized from selected teacher channels, with a separate zero-step export and the same 4,000-step local fit as the completed random-width967 control.
points.limitations: Both complete development batteries and the frozen aggregate reject this teacher-channel initialization policy at the primary serialized-byte budget. The initial export scores 34/1024 GSM and 61.6536% MC and fails all five gates. After 4000 updates, the selected fitted export scores 138/1024 GSM and 65.4948% MC, versus teacher 366/1024 and 66.5365%. It passes C4 and both copy gates but fails MC and GSM. Paired GSM gains are +20 over random967 (95% count interval [-4,44.025]) and +23 over sparse raw404 ([-1,48]); neither meets the prospectively fixed 30-item/positive-interval requirement. Fitting raises GSM by 104 items over initialization and repairs copy and stopping; it does not recover near-teacher reasoning. Answered-and-stopped counts are 0 initially and 898 after fitting; correctly answered-and-stopped counts are 0 and 129. Fitted marker-only correctness is 137 plus one last-number fallback. Training executed and selected step 4000, reducing local objective from 0.814512 to 0.249593, versus random967 final 0.269691; raw relative MSE is 0.236937 and centered r-squared 0.560100. Each native export occupies 23,769,007 serialized and 23,764,992 resident bytes. Training verification passed 354 checks over 116 bound files, following 47 CPU tests and 101 staging bindings; all H100 evaluations used the original regular-partition route. The aggregate retains no recipe and no replication candidate. This is one training seed on reused development items; it establishes neither an intrinsic capacity floor nor a final-test result. A full read-only replay reproduces the sealed aggregate exactly; separate gate, count and contender calculations agree. Both complete 1024-item GSM batteries, six 256-item MC tasks per arm, paired contrasts, stopping, source identities and native export checks are verified.

points.limitations: Both one-H100 3072-update mains and the allocated terminal collector have completed0:0. The exact historical common warm start scores52/64GSM and166/192MC. At the primary actual3072 endpoint, original1536windows replayed four times scores51/167; expanded6144distinct windows once scores49/165. All64 candidate traces answer and stop within two tokens, with no caps, fallback-corrects or follow-on questions. Expanded minus control gives GSM-2items paired95[-8,+3] (three gained/five lost), and MC-2[-6,+2] (one gained/three lost): no capability advantage is established. Expanded data improves C4 NLL by0.010264nats[-0.012572,-0.007950] and teacher-KL by0.005731[-0.007279,-0.004107]; copy improvements are also supported. C4 teacher-KL control/expanded is0.160430/0.154700, C4 NLL upper increase0.079836/0.069852, and copy512/2048 ratios0.99961/1.02416 versus0.97990/1.00876. The producer labels this C4 readout selection-only/no-admission. Each arm presents6144rows,3145728input positions,3139584predictive targets with matched4096prose/1024math/1024copy presentations; all79 cell/adapter/norm tensors change and every actual/saved Adam counter reaches3072. Both fixed selectors choose their3072 endpoints, with matching full-state runtime hashes; secondary readouts are not replicates. The expanded pool changes unique count, source breadth and math difficulty together, so these effects are not separated. Each complete model registers58,530,029,553bytes, or1.101461260x; this is the older pristine-BF16-backbone experiment, not a descendant of the balanced3.37x parent. Endpoint deltas are857,113,930bytes control and857,113,927bytes expanded including seals, and still require the original retained backbone. Collector46110777 completed2026-09-13T02:37:30UTC after independently verifying all owned delta payloads, saved3072-step Adam counters and32/512/full-KV reload tensors; the read-only audit separately crosschecks exact item/stopping counts. Full frozen capability admission remains untested; no shortlist change or reliable capability gain.
